description: `--notify` on a passing run under Jest 30.5.2 (B23d A4): the default mode is `failure-change` and this is the first run, so Jest notifies once: title `<package> - 100% Passed`, message `<n> tests passed` (with a check mark on macOS only). The project's `node_modules/node-notifier/index.js` is a fake that appends each call's options (without the check or stop sign Jest puts before the message on macOS only) to `notify.json`; the icon path is masked. One Jest worker. A black-box run.
